title: 8 Watercolor Cocktail Clipart Bundle PNG
author: Nice Ass Design Co
description:
Bring a splash of style to your creative projects with this Watercolor Cocktail Clipart Collection, featuring 8 beautifully hand-painted drink illustrations. Each cocktail is crafted in a soft, artistic watercolor style with delicate textures, fresh color tones, and refined detailing—perfect for both modern and relaxed summer aesthetics.
This bundle blends tropical fun with upscale elegance, making it ideal for designers, creators, and small business owners who want eye-catching beverage artwork that feels both premium and playful.
From citrus-filled spritzers to bold, colorful cocktails, this set gives you versatile drink graphics ready to elevate any design project.
🍸 What’s Included:
8 individual watercolor cocktail PNG illustrations
A curated mix of tropical, fruity, and classic cocktail styles
Garnishes including citrus, herbs, ice, and decorative accents
💥 Perfect For:
Luxury cocktail menus & bar branding
Summer party invitations & event stationery
Sublimation & print-on-demand products
Stickers, decals & planner accessories
Social media content & marketing visuals
T-shirts, tote bags & lifestyle merch
🎨 File Details:
PNG files – Transparent backgrounds
SVG file
✨ Design Style:
Hand-painted watercolor textures
Soft blended color gradients
Elegant, modern composition with a tropical twist
Balanced between fun, fresh, and sophisticated
Whether you’re building a summer collection, designing for a cocktail brand, or creating standout digital products, this clipart set delivers a polished, high-impact visual upgrade.
